patterns.name: Large heading
patterns.description: A large heading that reveals word-by-word behind a soft mask.

patterns.name: Text reveal
patterns.description: Short lines rise into view, one after another.

patterns.name: Image reveal
patterns.description: A media block that unmasks into view — vertical, horizontal, or zoom.

patterns.name: Moving image
patterns.description: A media block that drifts as the page scrolls — subtle, controlled depth.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Amount: tiny | small | medium (default small — avoid loud parallax)
Style: {{style}}

Wrap the media element; do not stretch the container.
Fully disables under reduced-motion — assume it will.

patterns.name: Scroll story
patterns.description: A sticky media column that changes chapter as the reading column scrolls past.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Style: {{style}}
Chapters: provide 3–6 chapter objects with { title, body, media }.

Assume mobile stacks the sticky media above each chapter — do not build
a bespoke small-screen layout unless the pattern's default is wrong for
your case.
Under reduced motion the media cross-fade disables; content stays present.

patterns.name: Image zoom
patterns.description: A media block starts contained and progressively crops toward full-bleed as you scroll.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Style: {{style}}
Optional caption: pass a short caption if useful.

Reserve for a single statement moment per page — not for every image.
Fully disables under reduced motion; the image stays in its inset frame.

patterns.name: Shuffle
patterns.description: A grid whose items re-order with a fluid layout transition.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Style: {{style}}
Provide items as [{ id, content }] — id is stable, content is what renders.
Shuffle uses Fisher-Yates; do not replace with sort(Math.random).
Layout transitions disable under reduced motion; the button still shuffles.

patterns.name: Marquee
patterns.description: A horizontal loop of labels or marks — pauses on hover, static under reduced motion.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Speed: slow | normal | fast (default normal)
Direction: left | right

Duplicate the content once inside — the pattern handles the loop.
Under reduced motion the row is static; never rely on the animation
to convey required information.

patterns.name: Magnetic object
patterns.description: A single element that follows the cursor within a soft field.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Mode: magnetic | tilt | follow | press

Use sparingly — one hero button, one specimen. Not every CTA.
Disables entirely on coarse pointers and under reduced motion.

patterns.name: Expanding panel
patterns.description: A small anchor becomes a larger content surface — used for FAQs and detail reveals.
patterns.prompt:
Add Valencia's "{{name}}" pattern to {{target}}.

Style: {{style}}
Provide items as [{ id, label, body }].

Anchor button announces aria-expanded and controls the body.
Under reduced motion the height animation disables; the panel toggles instantly.
